name: onboarding-plan
description: Design a 100-day customer onboarding plan with phase gates based on Never Lose a Customer Again by Joey Coleman. Use when user says "onboarding plan", "new customer onboarding", "customer kickoff", "first 90 days", "activation plan", "customer launch plan", "new customer journey", or "implementation plan" - even if they don't say "100 days" explicitly. Applies to CSMs designing structured onboarding programs that move customers from signed contract to full adoption.
